{{Quote|I call myself Destroyer because I aim to destroy the hold the Hutts have unjustly placed on this world. This world belongs to the Evocii. It is ours to plunder, not theirs. However many have to die to make this a reality is irrelevant.|Grov|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Grov''', also known as '''Grov the Destroyer''', was an [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]] gangster who rose to power on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Grov claimed to have become a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] in order to inspire other Evocii to try to attain power themselves, and he called himself "the Destroyer" as he sought to break the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]' hold on the Evocii's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Grov was eventually targeted by [[Lo'tar]], a lieutenant of one of the Hutts whom Grov attacked, and Lo'tar hired the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to deal with Grov and his lieutenants.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Grov first appeared in Game Update 2.3 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]]. He is only accessible through the Bounty Contract Week event as the Hutta Kingpin Bounty. He is voiced by [[Brian Bloom]].
